lines.text: I'm delulu, I think he'll text first.

data.define: Short for delusional; used playfully about big dreams.

example.text: I'm delulu, I think he'll text first.

misuse.text: Don't call a friend's real goal 'delulu'.
misuse.why: It mocks hopes that could come true.

publish.title: What does "delulu" mean?
publish.value: Delulu = Having unrealistic hopes. Example: "I'm delulu, I think he'll text first." (very casual English, US).
